Inspiration

Dear Julianne,

This is update number 3 to this website that I have made for you. While more updates will be made, one thing is for sure, my love for you will continue to grow and deepen as I progress through this website.

I can't wait to add Thanksgiving and Christmas photos with you this year and add them here to this collage of memories and loving moments that we got to share together.

I never really told you the reason for this website, but I hope that one day in 10, 15, even 20 years from now, I can pull this back up from my GitHub account and we can look through all the memories we made when we were young and in our 20's.

And I hope that the day that we look back at these memories from our early years, we both still have the same love for each other that we do right now.

Let this website serve as a permanent love letter, message, and even place to come back to when times are hard.

I mean every word I put into this website, I mean every word I say in person, and I hope this website means something to you :)

With love,Buggy
